markor.description:
Markor is a free, open-source text editor for Android that makes it easy to create notes, manage to-do lists, and work with plain-text documents, even without an internet connection.

Write and preview Markdown documents, organize tasks using todo.txt, and work with formats including Zim Wiki, AsciiDoc, CSV, JSON, YAML, and other text-based files. Syntax highlighting, formatting shortcuts, search, customizable action buttons, and automatic saving make editing efficient.

Markor includes a file browser, a configurable Notebook folder, QuickNote for capturing ideas, and dedicated To-Do and sharing tools. Preview formatted documents, export supported content to HTML or PDF, customize the appearance with dark themes, and use optional password-based AES-256 encryption for text files.

Your documents remain ordinary files that can be opened with other compatible applications. Markor works offline, displays no ads, and does not require an account. Cloud synchronization is not built in; external synchronization apps can be used when needed.

Developed by Gregor Santner and contributors, Markor is licensed under Apache 2.0.
